scope: I10 separate VWAP location and relative-volume conditioning; no VWAP+RVOL/HL/SR/ladder combinations.
formula: VWAP actual quote turnover/base volume, UTC day or Monday00:00 week prefix; incomplete first anchor invalid. Distance=100*(close-VWAP)/VWAP. Entry crossings require same anchor, no reset-only entries; exits use current anchored VWAP even after reset. RVOL=current base volume/mean PRIOR20 bars, or same completed UTC-slot on PRIOR20 calendar days; regular not cumulative, no missing-slot substitution. Zero denominator null, current zero volume valid0. Current close minus prior close supplies explicit direction, not taker aggression.
entryRules: VWAP entry-side signed distance: trend previous<=+k,current>+k (k0/.5/1/2); into previous>=-k,current<-k; recovery previous<=-k,current>-k (k.5/1/2). RVOL fresh previous<=k,current>k plus current close-change aligned(follow) or opposed(fade) to position side. Wrong-direction volume spikes expire; no catch-up. Plain price controls use every nonzero aligned/opposed close-change without volume entry gating; fixed12h control reference canonicalized to rolling20.
exitRules: 12h from fill or first subsequent VWAP zero condition (trend signed<=0; into/recovery signed>=0), or RVOL<=1 for relative-volume and own plain controls. Reference rolls with current UTC anchor; not frozen at entry. Timeout wins ties, no entry-observation exit; occupied/pending signals skipped, never queued.
timing: Contiguous finalized selected-timeframe bars; next minute-open, modeled0 publication lag or separate+1m every entry and exit. Full fixed seed; no execution-minute H/L/C at decision, no future bar or sliding reseed.
inventory: One independent $10k position; no compounding/averaging. Occupied/pending crossings skipped, fresh signal after exit. Open cutoff inventory marked including hypothetical close fee; not counted as completed.
funding: Excluded due incomplete settlement evidence. After trading fees before funding; no liquidation/shared-account/queue/live fills certification.
researchScreen: Same inherited screen: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and own-side clock delta allfour; no monthly marked delta below-1e-8; positive extra5bps/side and no equity exhaustion.
ranking: 640 strategies ranked by full0 delta to side clock; 60 plain controls separately retained. Descriptive sample/net/cost/solvent subset overall and per branch by full0 absolute net; retain raw top5 and own unfiltered-volume/fixed12h controls. For RVOL incremental evidence additionally report delta to own price control allfour and monthlies; never attribute its entire net to volume.
reporting: Full/recent W/L and dollar amounts, explicit clock and own price/exit baselines, open marks, DD, topfive monthly deltas both delays, extra costs, paths/concentration, all700 definition slots with 4 I01 repeats. Same old baseline exactly; not the ladder.
limitations: Previously mined overlapping windows; only daily/weekly scheduled anchors, not hindsight swing or damage anchors. Not an exhaustive volume pass: OBV/MFI/CMF, cumulative RVOL, other periods/time-of-week normalization, volume-low filters, indicator/HL/SR combos, ladder, funding, actual arrival/liquidation/shared-margin and queue/slippage remain untested.
writes: New local artifact directory only, refuses overwrite. Source/card/findings/register edits in scope, no commit/push/live changes.
